<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import {
  DropdownMenuContent,
  type DropdownMenuContentEmits,
  type DropdownMenuContentProps,
  DropdownMenuPortal,
  useForwardPropsEmits,
} from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<DropdownMenuContentProps>(),
  {
    sideOffset: 4,
  },
);
const emits = defineEmits<DropdownMenuContentEmits>();

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <DropdownMenuPortal>
    <DropdownMenuContent
      data-slot="dropdown-menu-content"
      v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
      class="sigma-ui-dropdown-menu-content"
      :class="$attrs.class"
    >
      <slot />
    </DropdownMenuContent>
  </DropdownMenuPortal>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-dropdown-menu-content {
  z-index: 50;
  overflow: hidden;
  min-width: calc(var(--spacing) * 32);
  padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 1);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--backdrop-filter-blur));
  background-color: var(--popover);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  color: var(--popover-foreground);
  transform-origin: var(--reka-dropdown-menu-content-transform-origin);
}

.sigma-ui-dropdown-menu-content[data-state="open"] {
  animation: sigma-ui-fade-in-scale 200ms ease-out;
}

.sigma-ui-dropdown-menu-content[data-state="closed"] {
  animation: sigma-ui-fade-out-scale 100ms ease-in forwards;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { DropdownMenuItem, type DropdownMenuItemProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<DropdownMenuItemProps & {
  /** Adds left padding to align with items that have an icon or indicator. */
  inset?: boolean;
}>();

const forwardedProps = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <DropdownMenuItem
    data-slot="dropdown-menu-item"
    v-bind="{ ...forwardedProps, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    class="sigma-ui-dropdown-menu-item"
    :class="[{ 'sigma-ui-dropdown-menu-item--inset': inset }, $attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </DropdownMenuItem>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-dropdown-menu-item {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 1.5) calc(var(--spacing) * 2);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  cursor: default;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  line-height: 1.25rem;
  outline: none;
  transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease;
  user-select: none;
}

.sigma-ui-dropdown-menu-item--inset {
  padding-left: calc(var(--spacing) * 8);
}

.sigma-ui-dropdown-menu-item:focus {
  background-color: var(--secondary);
  color: var(--secondary-foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-dropdown-menu-item[data-disabled] {
  opacity: 0.5;
  pointer-events: none;
}
</style>
